facts.text: Undergraduate degree requirements include nine hours of required Bible courses and six hours of Bible electives.

sources.title: Bible and Ministry (B.A.) - Oklahoma Christian University
sources.quote: 9 HOURS REQUIRED BIBLE. BIBL-1013 Israel and God's Kingdom (OT Survey) BIBL-1033 Jesus, the Church, and God's Kingdom (NT Survey) BIBL-2103 The Christian Life in God's Kingdom (NT Ethics) 6 HOURS BIBLE ELECTIVES.
